description: Kenyan administrative and electoral divisions: counties, constituencies, wards, sub-counties, localities and areas.
attribution: kenya-locations (https://github.com/DavidAmunga/kenya-locations), with data from the Independent Electoral and Boundaries Commission (IEBC) and the Kenya National Bureau of Statistics (KNBS).

sources: KNBS 2019 Kenya Population and Housing Census (capital, area_km2, population_2019)
IEBC county assembly ward codes 0001–1450 (2012 delimitation)

sub_county_code: Administrative Wards in Kenya 1450, American Red Cross via the Humanitarian Data Exchange (CC BY), DHIS2 ids, dataset dated 2016-03-31, last modified 2019-04-12 (attribute table in sources/hdx-kenya-wards/kenya_wards.dbf)
wards.json.notes: sub_county_code links each ward to a DHIS2 sub-county. 1,346 wards match the HDX ward layer by exact name; the other 104 are matched by similar name or inferred from their constituency, and are listed in sources/hdx-kenya-wards/matches.json for review.

sources: Kenya Sub Counties, American Red Cross via the Humanitarian Data Exchange (CC BY), DHIS2 sub-counties, dataset dated 2019-12-12, last modified 2020-09-01 (attribute table in sources/hdx-kenya-wards/ke_subcounty.dbf)
sub-counties.json.notes: Third-party DHIS2 sub-counties (the health information system's), not an official KNBS or IEBC list. They are close to constituencies: 297 of 302 sit inside one constituency. Two layer entries with no wards (Tiaty in Baringo, Kalama in Machakos) are left out. Codes are assigned by this project: the IEBC county code plus two digits in the source layer's order. See history.json for the old codes.

locality.json.notes: Provenance not yet documented. Stable IDs and ward links are planned for 0.12.

area.json.notes: Provenance not yet documented. Stable IDs are planned for 0.12.
